That package publishes source, not a build, and spells its own relative imports `.ts` so one file can be both a node module and a vite module; a program that typechecks through it therefore needs `allowImportingTsExtensions` (see packages/docs-kit/tsconfig.json). `tsconfig.build.json` turns the flag back off, because it emits.
